title: Chapter 1064
paragraphs: Chapter 1064
Episode 252. The War Begins (3)
Boom...!
The fleets of the Alliance and Kinzelo began to bombard again. However, unlike before, the bombardment did not extend straight to the Tower of Story.
As if malfunctioning.
The main canons of all ships, except for the black fleet of the Abyss Legion, were curving.
Yet, no crew members were alarmed. The reason the cannons were not shooting straight was not due to the distortion of the Origin Stone.
Battle Goddess Vahn.
She was deploying her energy and controlling the bombardment.
The main canons of the golden fleet were fired by power, namely the heart of light energy. Therefore, fundamentally, that power was the Plutonian' light energy.
Likewise, Kinzelo's ships, excluding the black fleet, used light energy modeled after the Plutonian's power. Vahn could easily control that as well. It was something only she could do.
"The impure light energy mixed in is somewhat displeasing, but since they seem usable for Brother Jin, I'll let them for now."
Fzzt, swoosh-!
Around the Tower of Story, the entire sky began to ripple with azure beams.
From a distance, it might look like a dancing blue yarn. The sight of hundreds of beams intertwining, unraveling, and swirling was as magnificent as a grand fireworks display.
The beautiful and intense dance of blue beams did not create any dissonance with the vast Eternal Flames that Jin had unfolded.
The two powers were in harmony as if they were one from the beginning.
Fire and lightning, sharp blue waves, magic swords, and the Plutonian Domination Sword.
The azure storm had spread so vast that it was now covering the entire Tower of Story.
Plutonian Battle God Sword Technique, 10th Sword
Plutonian Domination Sword - Open
As soon as she began to deploy the technique, Vahn smiled broadly.
It was comfortable.
Her prime was long past, and she had passed on the Battle God Blood and the Thunder Sword Sigurd to Jin. Every time she unfolded the Sovereign Demon Sword, Vahn felt a sense of regret.
The Battle God Techniques were originally more destructive.

It wasn't impossible to replicate the same level of the sword as before, but it would have been strenuous for her diminished prowess. To begin with, she had not yet encountered an enemy capable of withstanding the full extent of the Plutonian Domination Sword.
However, now, Vahn felt as if she was unfolding the Plutonian Domination Sword in its most glorious days.
The incessant bombardment from the golden fleet.
Given time, that power could erase even continents, which perhaps, from the perspective of the Battle God, was merely a vast light energy.
It might be a power that cannot kill gods, cannot change predestined fates, cannot insult the world with its distortions, just a brute force.
Yet, that mere brute force of light energy blooms anew along the Battle God Sword.
It becomes the Battle God's.
Will is imbued, a sharpness no one else has ever possessed, and transcendence begins.
[I have waited half a millennium to annihilate you.]
As soon as those words were spoken, the second chapter of the technique commenced.

Unlike before, there were no significant visible changes to the appearance of the Plutonian Domination Sword even after the battle started. However, the light energy pierced deeper into the enemies' vitals, and the vibrating light streams tore the Tower of Story to pieces more fiercely.
Jin, Luna, Vahn. All phantom troops near the three Genesis had already vanished without a trace.
Even the real magicians, just departing from the central part of the Tower of Story, were already on their knees. Despite being more than 5 miles away from the Genesis, they dared not rise again.
The eyes of the barely lifted phantom troops were ablaze.
It was the heat of Eternal Flames and the Plutonian Domination Sword. The rest of their faces and bodies turned to ashes before they could even register the pain.
The Tower of Story, a grand illusion, was burning. Zipple was experiencing a disaster it had never encountered before.
"With all this effort, it's about time for at least one worthy opponent to show up, isn't it?"
Runcandel Magic Sword Technique
Crimson Sword 1st Form – Strike
Amid the turmoil, a streak of crimson sword energy flew towards the center of the Tower of Story.
Luna Runcandel, the White Whale, had begun her assault.

Illusions were crumbling, and distortions were caught in the heat of Eternal Flames, unable to operate. As Jin and Vahn pressured the Tower of Story and bound the power of the Origin Stone, she could focus solely on the attack.
As if not a human but a beam of light was crossing.
With every step Luna took, a crimson afterimage remained. Her irregular sword marks were left all over the hull, which upon a closer look, were not random but precisely opening a path.
Screeching, clunking, clunking, clunking!
Similar to how the Red Plutonian once formed walls with their lighting waves, solid magical power surged near Luna, who was charging forward.

However, the deep crimson power Luna had seized was not at all hindered by these walls of magic. The blade of the Krantel, tainted red, showed its majesty by tearing down the magic walls even before making direct contact.
Like a leading rider charging forward, every time Luna moved towards the center of the hull, the Plutonian Domination Sword and Eternal Flames followed closely behind her.
It seemed only a matter of time before the tower would vanish without a trace.
[Ha, what a sight, truly magnificent. Vahn, that guy, never fought so neatly in all those dimensions I battled in. With Jin Runcandel and Luna as well, it sends shivers down my spine.]
Orgal, watching from the bridge of the Gruenil, spoke.
He was trembling with overwhelming emotion.
"Keep your dignity, master. You've become strange after learning the truth of the world."
[Zephyrin, you've always fought alongside me. How can you not be moved by such a sight?]

Zephyrin shrugged her shoulders. She was indeed moved, even calming herself internally with the thought that if Kinzelo had continued to wage war with the Vamel Alliance without knowing the truth, they would have been the first to vanish. Moreover, the benefits would have been reaped by Zipple, the nemesis of countless worlds.

"It's impressive, indeed. I just wished to have my revenge on Lord Jin at least once, but that's disappointing. Looking back, I've always been on the receiving end. Anyway, now's not the time for sentimentality. What do you think? They won't just sit still."
[Zipple is definitely at a disadvantage. But they won't just take it lying down. I think that damned Bligiet might show up.]
No sooner had Orgal finished speaking than a mass resembling a small sun emerged at the center of the Tower of Story.
It was Bligiet.
As soon as he appeared, all energies enveloping the tower were submerged into a brilliant white light.
It was but a blink of an eye. Though brief, Bligiet alone had blocked the energies of the three Genesis.
Zipple hurriedly activated the Origin Stone to recover part of the destroyed hull. They had originally wanted to perform a spatial leap to escape the battlefield but were unable to.
"Bligiet... You must have regretted not being able to cut me last time."
Once again, Eternal Flames, the Plutonian Domination Sword, and the Crimson Sword dominated the hull.

However, they could not advance to the center as quickly as before. Similar to their first battle in the Temple of the Sun God with Vahn, Bligiet had already formed shields around the center of the tower with sun energy, without any warning.
The energies of the Genesis pressing down on the Origin Stone were blocked by these shields. This meant that inside the shield, Zipple could reform their troops with the Origin Stone.
Three seconds.
It only took that long for the three swords to rip through the shields, but Zipple had fully opened the Origin Stone to summon grand magicians.
Including five past family heads resurrected from hell like Kimaros Zipple, along with their phantom troops.
Had they only summoned them, the alliance would have torn them all apart instantly, but with Bligiet's protection, they might last a bit longer.
Screech-!
Vahn's sword energy pounded on the shield in front of Bligiet. He expected to deal with the mortals more easily than during the battle in the Temple of the Sun God.
Thanks to the relaxation of most restrictions of the 'Airan Vermont' for fighting for Zipple now, Bligiet had regained more powers than when he first met Vahn.

"Kelliark Zipple, you said it would take at least half a year to lift Airan's restrictions. As expected, it was a lie. Well, it's for the best. After today, he won't make me wait any longer. Once we completely lifted Airan's restrictions through that unpleasant Origin Stone..."
At that moment, Bligiet had to watch as the shield in front of him shattered hopelessly like glass.
It was Vahn's sword energy. The energy did not stop even after breaking the shield and grazed Bligiet's cheek.

Splash! A golden droplet of blood flew, and Bligiet glared back at Vahn, ready to counter. However, what entered his view was not Vahn but the follow-up strike of crimson sword energy from Luna. Bligiet had to dive sharply to avoid the attack, and the energy struck Zipple's troops he was protecting directly.

Like Chiron's sword, the magicians touched by the sword energy dispersed into particles, swirling away to somewhere. Moreover, the Crimson Sword was not just passing through them but ricocheting inside Bligiet's shield like light reflected off a mirror.
"Kraaack!"
"Cough!"
Bligiet's shield turned out to be a misstep. The Crimson Sword continued its massacre, bouncing off all sides of the punctured shield except the front.
Bligiet was too slow to deactivate the shield, as Vahn and Luna's sword energies continued to fly in.
While the Genesis battled atop the tower's hull, the alliance's fleet provided bombardment support, closing in on the Tower of Story.
This was to deploy the alliance's newly developed troops along with the golden fleet.
[ELO-2, launch. Ensure that the swords of the Genesis don't even momentarily aim at those insignificant phantoms.]
